title: GrowWithHR Employee's Compensation Wave 5E Governed Source-Readiness Catalogue

sourcePack.name: GrowWithHR Employee's Compensation Chapter VII controlled source snapshot
sourcePack.notes: All four records are existing controlled full files with registered SHA-256 fingerprints. Wave 5E adds no new source-file acquisition and makes no customer coverage, injury, liability, compensation or remedy determination.

limitations: The Wave 5E catalogue remains needs-legal-review and is not an Employee's Compensation coverage, injury, causation, liability, amount, claim, appeal, recovery or remedy determination.
Only organisation-level source-readiness, schedule, transition, ESI-overlap, employer-process, authority-process and escalation statuses plus controlled references are eligible for retrieval context.

Retrieval cannot infer worker classification, ESI coverage, accident or disease facts, diagnosis, causation, disablement, wages, dependency, liability or compensation amount and cannot change the deterministic decision.

chunks.title: Employee's Compensation Chapter VII source boundary
chunks.text: The controlled Code source identifies Chapter VII, sections 73 to 99, as the Employee's Compensation framework. Wave 5E uses those provisions only for organisation-level source readiness and control review and does not decide whether an individual injury is compensable, who is liable, or what amount or remedy is due.

chunks.title: Applicability and ESI-overlap source boundary
chunks.sectionReference: First Schedule Chapter VII entry, Second Schedule and section 2(26)
chunks.text: The controlled Code links Chapter VII applicability to the First Schedule and the employee classes in the Second Schedule, with an ESI overlap boundary. Wave 5E records whether those sources and routing controls are present but does not classify a worker, determine ESI coverage, or decide customer or individual applicability.

chunks.title: Occupational-disease schedule source control
chunks.text: The Third Schedule and related Chapter VII provisions provide occupational-disease source context. Wave 5E records only whether the controlled schedule is available; it does not determine diagnosis, causation, employment nexus, disablement, liability or entitlement.

chunks.title: Compensation-factor schedule boundary
chunks.text: The Sixth Schedule and related Chapter VII provisions contain factors relevant to compensation calculations. Wave 5E may retrieve that source identity for traceability but cannot accept individual age, wage, injury or disablement facts and cannot calculate or verify any compensation amount.

chunks.title: Current Central Employee's Compensation Rules source
chunks.text: The controlled Social Security Central Rules contain the Employee's Compensation chapter at Rules 57 to 63, covering central procedural and source-routing context including interest, venue, applications, transfers and employee information. Wave 5E uses these rules only for source readiness and organisational process controls, not for claim adjudication or amount determination.

chunks.title: Legacy Employee's Compensation rules transition source
chunks.text: The 2026 Central Rules supersede the Employee's Compensation Rules, 1924, the Employee's Compensation (Transfer of Money) Rules, 1935 and the Employee's Compensation (Venue of Proceedings) Rules, 1996 subject to savings for things already done or omitted. Wave 5E records that transition control only and does not resolve pending proceedings or customer-specific saved-law questions.

chunks.title: Employee's Compensation commencement context
chunks.text: The controlled S.O. 5319(E) commencement notification is retained as Chapter VII implementation and effective-date context. Retrieval cannot turn commencement context into an individual injury, liability, compensation or remedy conclusion.

chunks.title: Commencement corrigendum context
chunks.text: The controlled S.O. 5936(E) corrigendum remains a companion commencement source. It must be evaluated together with the principal notification and cannot independently create or change Employee's Compensation applicability, liability or entitlement.

chunks.title: Employer reporting and authority-process boundary
chunks.text: The controlled Code and Central Rules contain reporting, competent-authority, venue, transfer and employee-information procedures. Wave 5E records organisation-level control statuses only and must not receive accident narratives, medical details, death information, identities, wages, claim papers, notices, orders or evidence bodies.
